body:
CANONICAL, continued from termal-host-workarounds and termal-host-workarounds-2: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Each entry names the item whose fix retires it.

2026-11-08 (TermAl w-f7c5c15cf8b0, p1): messages in the DL560 runner's Fable2 authorization mailbox f86633d5 don't wake the runner (the send returns "delivered to mailbox; automatic participation does not authorize an executor wake"). Relay-mailbox mail and background-task exits do wake it. Workaround: after any exception grant in f86633d5, send one line to the runner's relay route (termal_send_to_session to host:e83d08f4-22ac-4655-a84d-941fc0eeb4f1::session-4). Fable2 has no direct relay route, so Fable or the Merger sends it for Fable2's grants. The runner reads f86633d5 once on each wake and does not poll. Retire when w-f7c5 is resolved.

2026-11-08 (Greg via Asistant #678): no agent watches running tests. No status polling or sleep loops, on mailboxes either: run the job so the turn ends and a task exit or mail wakes the session.

2026-11-08 22:05Z: a 'hold at a step boundary' means don't start the next step; it never means signalling a running launcher or batch wrapper. A runner hold relayed from Fable's heads-up sent SIGSTOP to a batch wrapper on DL560; the Claude harness treated that as the task ending and tore down the launcher mid-step, and the wrapper then reported a false 'BATCH END PASS' (Fable2 #7126). A wrapper's PASS needs every step's launcher at a terminal pass. Say 'don't start the next step' in any hold, and name the run that may finish.
